config.description: 与 DriveCreate.config 同形；secret_ref 原样返回，从不返回密钥值

confirm_mass_delete.description: 确认被 held 的代际

paths.description: G11/D47 targeted sync: stat only these paths and parents; never advances the generation or sweeps.

Block.description: oo.doc-ir/v1 block，见 contracts/docs-ir/doc-ir.v1.schema.json#/$defs/block；另加 src 字段（出处片段）

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency token of corrections: send as If-Match "r<revision>" to POST /facts/{id}:correct.

edit.description: decision=edit 时：fact 的 value/valid_from/valid_to，或 merge 的目标实体，或 alias 的归属实体

as_of_seq.description: 只处理该序号前入队的项，避免误收新项

target_dir.description: 仅守护进程填充，来自 mounts.json

command.description: 等价的 oo context mount 命令行（不含凭证）

Freshness.description: G12/G16, 00 §5.5. Priority held > degraded > syncing > processing > publishing > waiting_review > up_to_date.

ModelConfig.description: G3: the key value is never returned.

confirm.description: The id of the drive to rebuild. A full rebuild is manual and needs this confirmation (10 4.2, D23).

files.description: Files marked outdated; they are reprocessed at priority 900, one at a time, each new extraction judged by DOC-G10.

SuggestionRecord.description: oo.suggest/v1 (10 11.1). object and value: exactly one for the fact kinds. share_id only with the engine token (the collector); a share credential implies it.

supersedes.description: a [src:...] tag of the BRIEF or a fact_key

SuggestRequest.description: One record, or items (at most 50 records), or documents (at most 200 files read from suggest/: name, format md|json, text). Idempotent per share on idempotency_key or the content hash; no Idempotency-Key header.

items.description: A Suggestion, or {status: invalid, error, document?, code?} for a record or document that was refused.

SuggestionDiff.description: A draft for Desktop's revision mode; OO never writes the Drive. writable is true for an editor share; the write is Desktop's.

title: Super Ontology Docs Control API
description: docs-api/1.0-draft: spec 10 §8.2 with the §8.8 (G1-G3, G5-G15) and §16.10 (G16-G24) additions. Request objects are closed; response objects stay open so minor versions can add fields. Owned by the integration thread; every change carries a Contract-Version trailer (50 §6).
